snippet.title: Ukungu | Early Development Action RPG Showcase [Game Dev]
snippet.description:
🎮 *Ukungu — Early Development Showcase*

Hey everyone! I’m working on Ukungu as the main programmer, and this video is an early look at the game while it’s still in development.

For the latest Ukungu updates, check out the game’s main channel:
https://www.youtube.com/@griotwest

You can also watch the original showcase here:
https://youtu.be/CKk76PBwm4I

I may post programming updates, behind-the-scenes development work, and other projects I’m working on here in the future as well.

---

🎵 *Music*

*Original Track:* "No Time (Ukungu)"

*Written and performed by:*
KS The Wolf
https://www.instagram.com/ksthewolf/

*Track Composition:*
Darius Shipp
https://www.instagram.com/mrshipp/

---
